characters.name: Gabriel Conroy
characters.description: Teacher, literary reviewer, nephew of Kate and Julia, and Gretta's husband.

characters.name: Gretta Conroy
characters.description: Gabriel's wife, whose memory of Michael Furey transforms the final scene.

characters.name: Kate Morkan
characters.description: One of the Morkan sisters who hosts the annual dance.

characters.name: Julia Morkan
characters.description: Kate's sister, a singer in the Adam and Eve's church choir and co-host of the dance.

characters.name: Mary Jane Morkan
characters.description: Kate and Julia's niece, an organ teacher and co-host of the dance.

characters.name: Lily
characters.description: The caretaker's daughter who receives the guests and speaks sharply to Gabriel.

characters.name: Molly Ivors
characters.description: Gabriel's colleague and an Irish nationalist who challenges his cultural loyalties.

characters.name: Mr. Browne
characters.description: A convivial guest at the Morkans' annual dance.

characters.name: Freddy Malins
characters.description: A family friend whose drunken arrival worries the hosts.

characters.name: Mrs. Malins
characters.description: Freddy Malins's mother, visiting from Glasgow.

characters.name: Bartell D'Arcy
characters.description: The tenor whose singing of The Lass of Aughrim awakens Gretta's memory.

characters.name: Michael Furey
characters.description: Gretta's deceased youthful love from Galway.

characters.name: Miss Daly
characters.description: A guest who plays for the dancing and later carves the ham.

characters.name: Miss Power
characters.description: A guest at the Morkans' dance.

characters.name: Miss Furlong
characters.description: One of Mary Jane's pupils and a guest at the dance.

characters.name: Mr. Kerrigan
characters.description: A young male guest and dance partner.

characters.name: Mr. Bergin
characters.description: A young male guest and dance partner.

characters.name: Miss O'Callaghan
characters.description: A guest who leaves with Bartell D'Arcy and the Conroys.

characters.name: Ellen Conroy
characters.description: Gabriel and Constantine's deceased mother and the elder Morkan sister.

characters.name: T. J. Conroy
characters.description: Ellen's husband and Gabriel and Constantine's father.

characters.name: Constantine Conroy
characters.description: Gabriel's brother, a senior curate in Balbriggan.

characters.name: Patrick Morkan
characters.description: The deceased Morkan grandfather remembered through the story of his horse Johnny.

characters.name: Tom Conroy
characters.description: One of Gabriel and Gretta's children.

characters.name: Eva Conroy
characters.description: One of Gabriel and Gretta's children.

characters.name: Bessie
characters.description: The person trusted to look after Gabriel and Gretta's children.

characters.name: Johnny
characters.description: Patrick Morkan's horse, remembered in Gabriel's comic family story.
